title: tephrosia piscatoria
intro: Tephrosia piscatoria, commonly known as Fish Poison Tree, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family, native to tropical Africa. The health benefits of Tephrosia piscatoria include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Tephrosia piscatoria include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
